children: Where Classic Design Meets User Creativity: iCAUR Interprets “Classic Never Fades”

At the 2026 iCAUR International User Summit, 20 customized vehicles were on display, including three official customization models. The concept design by a Hong Kong winner and the real-vehicle build by a Malaysian designer show how personal interests and regional culture can find expression in a vehicle's design.

Building on its classic design language, iCAUR extends personalization across different lifestyles with three official customized models: the V25 Game Changer, V23 Forge, and V27 Sun Roam. All three are slated for launch by early 2027.

iCAUR has established official user clubs in nine countries and plans to extend its user clubs into more countries through its global Club Connect initiative in 2027. The brand will also set up dedicated areas for personalized customization displays in every showroom, giving user creativity a lasting channel into product and ecosystem development.
WUHU, China, Oct. 20, 2026

-- At the 2026 iCAUR International User Summit, iCAUR presented 20 customized vehicles under the theme "Classic Never Fades." Three of them are official customized models. The display showed how the brand brings together Future Classic Design, new energy technology, and user co-creation to help users express their individuality and make it part of everyday life. User creativity moves from shared ideas to real vehicles, and from there into a user ecosystem rooted in products, culture, and lifestyle. In doing so, iCAUR carries its classic design into the new energy era and brings it through with new life.
[Customization Event at the 2026 iCAUR International User Summit]
Starting with Personal Interests: Design for Different Lifestyles

How can a car bring together people who share the same interests? Wong Po Ying, Open Group champion at the Hong Kong iCAUR V23 AI Design Competition, presented "CYBER PARTY," a vision for a V23 with a deployable DJ stage and a rear bar counter — a mobile space that blends music, creativity, and outdoor socializing.

Chan Hui Fung Marcus, champion of the Student Group, designed his V23 Omni-X to move between different sides of daily life. In this modular concept, the tailgate turns into a coffee workspace, while the trunk can be fitted with tool drawers and a folding repair bench for bike repairs. Both designs turn personal interests into practical features and open up new ways to expand what a vehicle can do.

Malaysian designer Wang Weiquan brings his hometown into a real vehicle. Daniel Lai Seng Kong, iCAUR's representative in Malaysia, presented the design on Wang's behalf: three young people of different ethnicities stand side by side looking into the distance, while details on the roof and body incorporate elements of the local national flag and national flower. Moving from industrial design to graphic design, Wang now looks at how vehicles read visually from different angles. Seeing the design move from screen to the body of a real vehicle left him deeply excited and gave co-creation a tangible outcome.
[Global User Creativity at 2026 iCAUR International User Summit]
Classic Design Sets the Foundation, User Creativity Enriches Official Customization

These user expressions are also the starting point for the brand's effort to grow customization culture. Ronna, CEO of iCAUR International, said that classic design should be recognized by users today and still appreciated years later, while leaving room for personal expression. In global markets, 50% of iCAUR users customize their vehicles, and their creativity also feeds into product evolution.
[iCAUR V-Series Officially Customized Vehicles and All New V25]

The three official customized vehicles embody this approach. The V25 Game Changer turns game-controller colors and gamepad cues into vehicle details, making digital-life passions visible in the design; the V23 Forge keeps its boxy silhouette, reinforcing its stance with widebody wheel arches, an upright grille, and gloss-black trim; the V27 Sun Roam draws inspiration from 1980s off-road vehicles and vintage cameras, pairing rugged proportions with refined details for those drawn to exploration and well-made journeys. The three models share a classic design foundation, yet each has a personality of its own. They are slated for launch by early 2027, with timing subject to local regulations and market conditions.
Co-creation, On Site and in Local Communities
[Group Photo of Brand Ambassadors]

Keeping creativity flowing into products and daily life requires long-term exchange. iCAUR has established official user clubs in nine countries and plans to extend its user clubs into more countries through the global Club Connect initiative in 2027, with user feedback feeding directly into product and experience improvements. That night, iCAUR named its first brand ambassadors. Going forward, it will continue to recognize, through Club Connect, users who have contributed to the brand and its community.

At the same time, iCAUR plans to set up dedicated display areas for personalized customization in every showroom and showcase customized classic models alongside future new-vehicle launches. Design concepts become real vehicles, and those vehicles spark experience sharing within local communities. Through this, iCAUR keeps users' creativity flowing into the brand's evolution — giving "Classic Never Fades" a living meaning.
About iCAUR

Chery Group’s iCAUR is a new energy automotive brand driven by Future Classic Design and technology. Guided by its design philosophy, iCAUR combines classic design elements with modern aesthetics and technology to develop distinctive vehicles for urban mobility and outdoor exploration. With a focus on product innovation and customization, iCAUR offers diverse vehicle choices and personalization options, extending its brand experience through user services and a growing range of user engagements initiatives.

iCAUR’s product portfolio is supported by technologies including i-AWD intelligent electric all-wheel drive and the REEV Golden Range Extender, delivering performance and capability for a range of driving conditions. With a growing presence in more than 40 markets worldwide, iCAUR continues to expand its international business and user engagements, guided by its brand belief: Classic Never Fades.
